outcome.technical: One shared question, runnable_tasks(manifest, phase_id) in drive-phase.py (the phase's tasks _status_facts.ready_tasks names, or in progress), asked before a sign-off decision or a wave member's start. (1) pending_still_applies: a decision with no task (every one of sign-off's) no longer applies while a task is runnable, so drive_locked sets it aside with a did-line naming the task and drive_phase runs it; an --answer sent to the set-aside decision is refused (exit 2) naming the runnable task; a blocked or waiting task leaves the decision standing. (2) Triage: new answer `leave` (DECISIONS['triage'], needs --reason) with --fix <ids>, refused by leave_refusal for no --fix or an id the triage does not offer; recorded in drive state LEFT_FIELD ('leftOpen'), read by left_now (shared _answered_open with carried_now), excluded from the offered findings in triage() and refresh_triage(), shown as 'left open' lines, and recorded by run_signoff as --accept-open id=<the leave reason>. fix_takes(finding) is the one predicate the offer (finding_lines options, render_triage's fix answer line, which now names the findings it takes) and fix_refusal both ask, so a finding naming a cancelled fix task is offered [leave] (or [carry|leave]) and never fix. (3) step_member drops an unstarted member that not_ready_why says is not ready ('dropped', why); walk_wave removes it from wave.tasks and prints '<id> dropped from wave <wave>, not started: waits on <refs>', and the walk goes on. (4) run_brief: for --role executor on an in-progress task whose brief --read finds none (started by the verb), it writes the brief through the audit-lookup call dispatch makes, then reads it back; a never-started task is not attempted.
